notes:
Top tier Japanese Hadatai workshop, THE original Hadatai maker. Slightly higher prices, higher quality materials, stronger stitching. Wide variety of flesh color tones available. 

 Their custom ordering has some of the most attention to detail available, yet designed to stay approachable. Instead of fiddly spot measurements (like each finger), they use things like handprint scans so you get the best fit with the least work. 

  Prices listed are starting prices, options, materials and other addons can add to the cost.
